blocked.name: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
blocked.why: 'Three times that many' applies only to creature tokens (the token multiplier has no filter), and the Temple's 'if you attacked with three or more creatures this turn' has no count of attackers.

blocked.name: Dusk // Dawn
blocked.why: A split card with aftermath: no split-card layout (two castable halves, a graveyard-only half).

blocked.name: Agadeem's Awakening // Agadeem, the Undercrypt
blocked.why: 'Any number of target creature cards that each have a different mana value X or less': a variable target count with a constraint across the set.

blocked.name: Blightsteel Colossus
blocked.why: Infect, and 'if it would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, shuffle it into its owner's library instead'.

blocked.name: Approach of the Second Sun
blocked.why: 'You win the game', read off a game-long record of spells named Approach cast, and 'seventh from the top'.

blocked.name: Krosan Verge
blocked.why: 'Search your library for a Forest card and a Plains card' — one search whose two finds each meet a different filter, entering together.

blocked.name: All Is Dust
blocked.why: A Kindred Sorcery — Eldrazi: the engine has no kindred type, so it would be neither an Eldrazi spell (Eldrazi Temple's mana) nor two card types in a graveyard.

blocked.name: Mechanized Production
blocked.why: 'If you control eight or more artifacts with the same name as one another, you win the game.'

blocked.name: Mines of Moria
blocked.why: 'Exile three cards from your graveyard' as part of an activation cost.

blocked.name: Windborn Muse
blocked.why: 'Creatures can't attack you unless their controller pays {2} for each' — the Propaganda tax.

blocked.name: Combat Celebrant
blocked.why: Exert as it attacks, with a 'when you do' trigger.

blocked.name: Spellskite
blocked.why: 'Change a target of target spell or ability to this creature.'

blocked.name: Force of Vigor
blocked.why: 'If it's not your turn, you may exile a green card from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost.'

blocked.name: Necromancy
blocked.why: Becomes an Aura with 'enchant creature put onto the battlefield with Necromancy' and attaches to the returned creature; and the cleanup sacrifice only when cast at instant timing.

blocked.name: Nyxbloom Ancient
blocked.why: 'If you tap a permanent for mana, it produces three times as much of that mana instead' — a mana replacement.

blocked.name: Omniscience
blocked.why: 'You may cast spells from your hand without paying their mana costs': alternativeCostForSpells can't be limited to the hand, and a card with an alternative cost of its own would be offered only that one.

blocked.name: Combustible Gearhulk
blocked.why: 'Target opponent may have you draw three cards. If the player doesn't, you mill three cards, then … damage equal to the total mana value of those cards' — a choice by a targeted opponent between two of your effects.

blocked.name: Heliod, Sun-Crowned
blocked.why: 'As long as your devotion to white is less than five, Heliod isn't a creature.'

blocked.name: Wear // Tear
blocked.why: A split card with fuse.

blocked.name: Training Grounds
blocked.why: 'Can't reduce the mana in that cost to less than one mana', and it reaches creatures' mana abilities, which abilityCostModification leaves alone.

blocked.name: Arcane Lighthouse
blocked.why: 'Creatures your opponents control lose hexproof and shroud and can't have hexproof or shroud' until end of turn.

blocked.name: Charismatic Conqueror
blocked.why: 'They may tap that permanent. If they don't, you create a token' — the ruling says they can't choose to tap one that's already tapped or gone, but each-player-may offers its effect regardless.

blocked.name: Wayward Swordtooth
blocked.why: Ascend and the city's blessing.

blocked.name: The Reality Chip
blocked.why: Reconfigure, and 'you may look at the top card of your library any time'.

blocked.name: Pest Infestation
blocked.why: 'Destroy up to X target artifacts and/or enchantments.'

blocked.name: Three Steps Ahead
blocked.why: Spree: a mode per additional cost.

blocked.name: Fertile Ground
blocked.why: 'Adds an additional one mana of any color' on a land tapped by hand: a tapped-for-mana extra of any colour is made white there, with no choice.

blocked.name: Tataru Taru
blocked.why: 'Target opponent may draw a card' — a may answered by a targeted player — and 'if it isn't that player's turn'.

blocked.name: Marvin, Murderous Mimic
blocked.why: 'Has all activated abilities of creatures you control that don't have the same name.'

blocked.name: Mesmeric Orb
blocked.why: 'Whenever a permanent becomes untapped' — no untap trigger.

blocked.name: Jace, Wielder of Mysteries
blocked.why: 'If you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, you win the game instead.'

blocked.name: Slip Out the Back
blocked.why: 'It phases out.'

blocked.name: Ugin, the Ineffable
blocked.why: +1 exiles a card face down that only you may look at, and 'when that token leaves the battlefield, put the exiled card into your hand' links the card to the token.

blocked.name: Ram Through
blocked.why: 'If the creature you control has trample, excess damage is dealt to that creature's controller instead.'

blocked.name: Not Dead After All
blocked.why: Creates a Wicked Role token attached to the returned creature.

blocked.name: Restoration Magic
blocked.why: Tiered: choose exactly one mode, each with its own additional cost.

blocked.name: Ocelot Pride
blocked.why: Ascend and the city's blessing, then a token copy of each token that entered this turn.

blocked.name: Mishra's Bauble
blocked.why: 'Look at the top card of target player's library' — a private look at another player's library.

blocked.name: Alchemist's Refuge
blocked.why: 'You may cast spells this turn as though they had flash.'

blocked.name: Nezahal, Primal Tide
blocked.why: 'Discard three cards' as an activation cost.

blocked.name: Great Train Heist
blocked.why: Spree: a mode per additional cost.

blocked.name: Kozilek, Butcher of Truth
blocked.why: 'When Kozilek is put into a graveyard from anywhere, its owner shuffles their graveyard into their library.'

blocked.name: Skrelv, Defector Mite
blocked.why: Toxic 1, and 'hexproof from that color' for a chosen colour.

blocked.name: Well of Lost Dreams
blocked.why: 'You may pay {X}, where X is less than or equal to the amount of life you gained' — X chosen on resolution.

blocked.name: Flare of Duplication
blocked.why: 'You may choose new targets for the copy', and 'sacrifice a nontoken red creature rather than pay this spell's mana cost'.

blocked.name: Twilight Prophet
blocked.why: Ascend and the city's blessing.

blocked.name: Deflecting Palm
blocked.why: 'The next time a source of your choice would deal damage to you this turn, prevent that damage' and redirect it.

blocked.name: Gisela, Blade of Goldnight
blocked.why: 'Prevent half that damage, rounded up' to you and your permanents.

blocked.name: Teferi, Time Raveler
blocked.why: 'Each opponent can cast spells only any time they could cast a sorcery.'

blocked.name: Augur of Autumn
blocked.why: 'You may look at the top card of your library any time.'

blocked.name: Grim Haruspex
blocked.why: Morph.

blocked.name: Fiery Inscription
blocked.why: 'The Ring tempts you.'

blocked.name: Revel in Riches
blocked.why: 'At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control ten or more Treasures, you win the game.'

blocked.name: Mirrormade
blocked.why: Enters as a copy of an artifact or enchantment.

blocked.name: Grasp of Fate
blocked.why: 'For each opponent, exile up to one target nonland permanent that player controls.'

blocked.name: Plumb the Forbidden
blocked.why: 'Sacrifice one or more creatures' as an additional cost, and a copy per creature.

blocked.name: Soul Shatter
blocked.why: Each opponent sacrifices one with the greatest mana value among the creatures and planeswalkers they control.

blocked.name: Silent Arbiter
blocked.why: 'No more than one creature can attack each combat' and the same for blocks.

blocked.name: Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore
blocked.why: Enters as a copy of a creature you control, except it's a Shapeshifter Rogue too.

blocked.name: Crackle with Power
blocked.why: 'Each of up to X targets.'

blocked.name: Tarrian's Soulcleaver
blocked.why: 'Put a +1/+1 counter on equipped creature' from a trigger about another object: no effect reference to the equipped creature.

blocked.name: The Black Gate
blocked.why: 'Choose a player with the most life or tied for most life', then a can't-be-blocked-by-that-player's-creatures restriction.

blocked.name: Triumph of the Hordes
blocked.why: Grants infect.

blocked.name: Zopandrel, Hunger Dominus
blocked.why: 'Sacrifice two other creatures' as an activation cost.
